style: Match the style of the reference image exactly: a flat risograph print using strictly four inks (teal, warm yellow, coral, deep blue) with overprint blending where shapes overlap, a slight print grain and misregistration, no outlines, simple stylised shapes, calm and not cartoony. Use only the inks that suit the subject's natural colours; an icon does not need all four inks.
frame: Draw one single icon, centred, filling about 80 percent of a square frame, on a plain solid pure white background. No text, no border, no paper texture or grain outside the icon, no cast shadow.
